posts.name: Beam.win
posts.tagline: Run AI agents on one Mac and use its windows on another
posts.description: Keep your agents and builds running on a Mac mini or Studio. Beam brings their Terminal, browser and other app windows onto the Mac in front of you, each as its own window with a Dock icon and ⌘Tab presence. Encrypted between your Macs. Free to try.

posts.name: face2social
posts.tagline: Search By Face. Know Who's Real.
posts.description: Is this investor, founder, recruiter, or potential business partner who they claim to be? Searching their name might return thousands of results. Searching their face can give you the edge. Upload a photo and face2social searches for matching faces across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X. Compare names, check public profile information, spot inconsistencies, and make better-informed decisions about who you're connecting with. Free preview. No match, no charge.

posts.name: Kai Resolve by Gleap
posts.tagline: Support that does the digging for you.
posts.description: Kai Resolve is the AI agent for support tickets your docs can't answer. It reads the screen recording, logs, account data and your code, read-only, then answers the customer or escalates with a diagnosis. Confirmed bugs become coding tasks your team reviews.

posts.name: readywhen
posts.tagline: The senior personal assistant that works inside WhatsApp
posts.description: readywhen is the senior Personal Assistant that works inside WhatsApp. It has its own phone number, its own computer, and a project board that keeps track of everything on your plate. Call it. Message it. Voice-note it. And it gets real work done.

posts.name: Figma Specs
posts.tagline: A container for your context that lives on the Figma canvas
posts.description: Figma Specs is a collaborative Markdown document that can live on its own or beside your designs. Embed Figma frames and FigJam diagrams, work through comments with teammates and agents, and pass the full context to coding agents through MCP.

posts.name: Beam
posts.tagline: Highly efficient agentic 501B parameter open model
posts.description: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 501 billion total parameters, 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.

posts.name: Wally by Willow
posts.tagline: Your Scribe agent that learns how you write
posts.description: Meet Wally, your new Scribe agent in Willow. Chat by voice to draft an email/slack/ prompt, rewrite highlighted text and keep refining it in the same conversation. Wally uses your personal context and learns your writing style as you go back and forth.

posts.name: Framefields
posts.tagline: Open-source code-first video for AGI era
posts.description: Framefields is a high-performance, code-first video engine powered by native WebGPU in Node.js. Built for AI agents and engineers, it replaces bulky creative suites with a single npm package: motion graphics, Photoshop-grade VFX, 3D scenes, and audio DSP. Zero Chromium or browser overhead—render deterministic, frame-accurate video and export hardware-accelerated MP4s directly from TypeScript.

posts.name: Lazy AWS
posts.tagline: A keyboard-driven home for your AWS resources
posts.description: Your AWS resources. One terminal. Browse, inspect, and run confirmed AWS CLI actions without leaving your keyboard.

posts.name: Switch Lab
posts.tagline: Hear and type on keyboard switches before you buy them
posts.description: Buying mechanical keyboard switches is a guessing game. Specs and YouTube videos don't tell you how a switch will sound and feel on your own desk. Switch Lab lets you press 100 switches with real recorded sounds, put them on a 3D keyboard, and swap between them instantly to compare. Filter by type, weight and sound, then test your pick with typing practice and mini games (typing marathon, drum stems, metro typing). No install, works on phone and desktop.

posts.name: Quello
posts.tagline: One place to ask, across everything you already use.
posts.description: Other tools search your files. Quello understands your work. One workspace for your tools, docs, and knowledge, with every answer backed by citations and a voice agent you can simply talk to. Built on MCP, it carries your full work context into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity. The context layer every AI has been missing.

posts.name: buddylist
posts.tagline: Chat with your coding agents like it's 2005
posts.description: A free desktop app for macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows and Linux that puts Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and OpenCode in an MSN-style buddy list. Use separate Git worktrees for separate jobs, or group-chat agents in a shared folder. Let them take turns, answer together or hand unfinished tasks to another agent. Review diffs, run terminals, preview your app and track PR checks beside the chat. Bring your own agent accounts; provider access and usage are separate.

posts.name: Tori
posts.tagline: The smartest AI support agent for customer success
posts.description: Tori AI support agent learns your product in depth from the content you already have, then delivers accurate answers to even the most complex customer questions through a UI you can fully customize.

posts.name: walkai-talkai
posts.tagline: Talk to your AI coding agent over a walkie-talkie
posts.description: Press PTT on any handheld radio and talk to your AI coding agent, hands-free. walkai-talkai transcribes your voice on your Mac with local Whisper, types the command into Cursor, Claude Code or Antigravity (or calls OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek or Ollama directly), then speaks the answer back over the radio with neural voice, VOX tones and a roger beep. Your radio audio never leaves your Mac. macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon. One-time lifetime license, no subscription.

posts.name: Lookout (for Slack)
posts.tagline: Urgent Slack messages, handled instantly. Powered by Jev.
posts.description: Using Jev, Lookout watches Slack for time-sensitive messages and takes the action you choose instantly.

posts.name: Own 1
posts.tagline: Own your data. Own your AI. A mind of your own.
posts.description: Own 1 is a fanless personal AI computer that runs two local LLMs and eight agents on your desk, from $3,899 with no subscriptions or per-token costs. What’s different: OwnXOS is AI-native, so every agent gets identity, budgets and an audit receipt, plus a wallet for x402 USDC payments. It bursts to OwnXCloud only when you allow it. Nexy, your private AI co-worker, ships on it and orchestrates hundreds of agents. Your data and memory stay local.

posts.name: CoolDock
posts.tagline: A smart second Dock for your Mac with 160+ live widgets.
posts.description: Add live widgets, quick actions, apps, folders, search, stats, weather, calendars, reminders, and more into a beautiful second Dock beside your original Mac Dock.

posts.name: croft
posts.tagline: Data pipelines in TypeScript, on one DuckDB file
posts.description: croft pulls data from APIs and files, transforms it with SQL or TypeScript, and keeps it fresh on a schedule. It all lives in one DuckDB file, every table gets a generated type, and Claude Code can drive it. Free, open source, no Python.

posts.name: Lancetta
posts.tagline: Know when to push your coding agents, and when to ease off
posts.description: Lancetta is a native macOS menu-bar app that tells you when and how to use Claude Code and Codex. From every quota reading it says what to do next: spend a window about to reset unused, slow down before an agent stops, move to the other agent while it has room. It checks what your agents load at every start, frees the background processes they leave behind, and keeps every session on one wall, the ones waiting on you first. Reading quota spends zero tokens. Free, signed, macOS 15+.

posts.name: CrawlForge MCP
posts.tagline: Give your AI agent 31 web tools in one MCP server
posts.description: CrawlForge MCP is an open-source MCP server that gives AI agents 31 web tools: scrape, search, crawl, extract structured data, browse in stealth mode, keep a browser session alive across calls and run multi-source research. Add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor with one npx command and your agent reads the live web as clean markdown or JSON. Pay per use from 1 credit a call, and start with 1,000 free credits, no credit card required.

posts.name: Planet-X
posts.tagline: A living globe to explore and remember loved ones
posts.description: Spin a free 3D globe, play a country’s live radio, or dig to the other side of Earth. Leave a light for a friend, family member, pet or idol you’ve lost. Exploring is free and needs no account.

posts.name: DoOne
posts.tagline: Focus timer with integrations with GitHub, Gitlab & More
posts.description: DoOne is a task list with a focus timer built in. You pick one task, and the timer runs for that task until you finish it or take a break. DoOne is built with power users in mind, with integrations such as Gitlab, GitHub, Linear, Sentry, Forgejo, Gitea, Webhooks, Todoist (n8n, IFTTT etc.), and more to come. You can complete a focus on DoOne and have it do multiple actions on your Github issue like assign, add labels etc. As an Engineer, I created it for myself and I love it.

posts.name: Triwarden
posts.tagline: Native Mac password manager for Vaultwarden & Bitwarden
posts.description: Triwarden is a native Mac app for Bitwarden and self-hosted Vaultwarden, built with Swift and SwiftUI. Get Touch ID unlock, password and passkey AutoFill, a global command palette, and Auto-Type for other apps. Manage multiple accounts with unified search, and use vault-stored SSH keys for authentication and Git signing. Open source and free for personal use, with a one-time license for work.

posts.name: Point and Yap
posts.tagline: Point at your screen and start yapping to your agent via MCP
posts.description: A small Mac tool I built for myself. Press Control twice and yap away while pointing at things on your screen, and it all goes to your coding agent via MCP, including what you pointed at and what you said. Free, open source, local.

posts.name: Rusteerio by Context.dev
posts.tagline: Keep your Cheerio code. Make it faster.
posts.description: Rusteerio is a Rust-powered, Cheerio-compatible HTML/XML library for Node.js. Keep the API you already know, swap one import, and process pages faster. Includes parallel batch extraction, prebuilt native binaries, and zero npm runtime dependencies.

posts.name: Starkomand
posts.tagline: Run your AI coding agents on an infinite canvas.
posts.description: Starkomand lets you run several AI coding agents at once on an infinite canvas. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any CLI agent with the plans you already pay for. - Auto picks the best model for each task - Pass work from one agent to another in one click - Talk to any agent with your voice - Quick recaps of what each agent did and what it needs from you - Diagrams and browser previews right beside each agent - Close your laptop and they keep working And more. No account, no subscription.

posts.name: Umbra Mail
posts.tagline: A calmer Gmail where emails look like chat threads
posts.description: A calmer, private Gmail. Emails can look like chat threads, newsletters go in one page, and AI is optional. No tracking, no server, open source.

posts.name: AutoChart.eu
posts.tagline: Turn any song into a full-band chart for YARG and Clone Hero
posts.description: Upload an MP3 or FLAC and get a complete song folder for YARG and Clone Hero: drums (pro cymbals, 2x kick), guitar, bass and vocals with word-timed lyrics, Easy to Expert, all charted by our own AI model. Every instrument gets its own audio track, so a missed note really drops out of the mix. No install, no GPU, no charting skills. First song free, no card needed; then from €1 per song, credits never expire.

posts.name: Pana Olai
posts.tagline: Digital Business Card & Lead Capture App
posts.description: Pana Olai is a digital business card that turns conversations into action. Create unlimited cards, share by QR or link, scan business cards and badges, and capture contacts offline. AI voice notes summarise conversations, create leads, update qualification details and set follow-up reminders. Enrich contacts and let people book meetings through your card. Plans start at $1/month, with credits for scanning and AI actions.

posts.name: PinReview
posts.tagline: Visual website feedback that turns comments into tasks
posts.description: PinReview turns client feedback into tasks. Clients click any element on a live or staging site and leave a comment, no account needed. Each comment arrives as a task on a Kanban board with an annotated screenshot, page URL, browser, viewport, and console errors. Review PDFs and images too, add the one-line script or use the Chrome extension, and connect Slack, webhooks, or AI coding tools via MCP. Free plan available.

posts.name: Holo AI
posts.tagline: Your marketing, on autopilot.
posts.description: Your marketing on autopilot. Holo AI turns your website into ads, emails, and social posts. Hundreds of content pieces created, while you sleep.

posts.name: Inklings Book Club
posts.tagline: 100 classic books, quizzes & read-aloud — free via libraries
posts.description: Inklings Book Club turns a library card into a reading adventure: 100 public-domain classics with excerpts and quizzes across 6 reading levels, plus read-aloud in the Professor's voice. Kids sign in with their library card — profiles are name and age only, no email, no ads, no data collected. Libraries get their own in-app pages, and 15 founding libraries are already live. Free forever for kids and libraries, because a library changed the maker's life. It can change a kid's too.

posts.name: Shoonya
posts.tagline: A context backed Hindu culture discovery platform 💛
posts.description: Shoonya is a Hindu culture app. Ask a question and get an answer grounded in scripture, with the sources shown. Follow Gita and Chanakya journeys, listen to aartis and chalisas with audio, and read a new sutra every day. For ages 13+.

posts.name: Ploof Studio for Mac
posts.tagline: Build, edit & publish AI websites on Mac
posts.description: Turn an idea into a live website with Ploof Studio, a native AI website builder for Mac. Generate complete websites from a simple prompt. Click any element to edit it with AI instead of prompting the entire page. Find and compare domain prices, then deploy in one click to Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, or GitHub Pages. Bring your own AI API key, export your code, and host anywhere. Your site. Your host. Your code.

posts.name: SkyLab
posts.tagline: Real collaboration for working with AI
posts.description: SkyLab gathers your team's prompts and skills into one workspace, then shares them with everyone who needs them. Watch the launch and try it free for 7 days.

posts.name: Lumina Markets
posts.tagline: Trade your world.
posts.description: Lumina Markets is a US prediction market platform. It turns the outcomes of real-world events, from elections and economic data to culture and climate, into tradable contracts whose prices reflect market-implied probabilities and that settle when the outcome is known.

posts.name: Assistemia
posts.tagline: Specialized AI tools for every stage of research
posts.description: Research needs more than one generic AI tool. Built by academics, AssistEmia brings 11 specialized tools into one platform to help you find studies and datasets, spot research gaps, explore theories, organize literature, check references, and improve manuscripts. Try it free and tell us which part of your research workflow needs the most help.

posts.name: Cognicore
posts.tagline: Where Your Agents Becomes Smarter
posts.description: One shared memory layer for Cursor, Aider, Claude Code, and every agent you run. Context persists across sessions, tools, and terminals.

posts.name: AppTrack Ninja
posts.tagline: Every App Store version, screenshot and icon, archived
posts.description: AppTrack Ninja tracks 1.8M+ App Store apps and 800K+ publishers as they move: new releases, soft launches, charts, app transfers and keyword ranks. Ask in plain language with AI Search, get a weekly AI briefing, and spot competitors early.

posts.name: AIFLIX
posts.tagline: Netflix for AI Movies and Series
posts.description: The AIFlix is the Netflix for AI content.

posts.name: AIFLIX
posts.tagline: Netflix for AI Movies and Series
posts.description: The AIFlix is the Netflix for AI content.

posts.name: ManySetter
posts.tagline: AI setter for Manychat that turns DMs into booked calls
posts.description: Manychat flows answer keywords. Real leads ask questions: “How much?”, “Will it work for me?”. ManySetter is an AI setter that plugs into the Manychat account you already use, on Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger. Paste your sales page: it writes your playbook (offer, voice, objections, setting script), qualifies each lead in your voice and books the call in your calendar. Follow-ups, human handoff and “Why this reply?” included. Build and test for free.

posts.name: SendHeron
posts.tagline: Email automation that sets itself up. You approve every word
posts.description: Lifecycle and transactional email for SaaS, on one account and one API. Paste your website URL and SendHeron proposes the tags and events your app should send, then drafts your welcome, trial, win-back and cancel-save sequences in your brand voice. You read every email and switch on only what you want. Visual sequence builder, REST API with a Node SDK, and several products under one subscription. 7-day free trial, plans from €19 a month.

posts.name: Decillion
posts.tagline: Put a team of AI agents on it
posts.description: AI agent teams in shared rooms. A lead agent delegates to specialists that work on the room's own cloud computer, while partners, clients and hires work in the same room. No per-seat fees.

posts.name: Zolie
posts.tagline: Answers in your voice, books clients, fills empty slots
posts.description: Zolie (formerly Callie) is the AI receptionist for spas, salons, and estheticians. She answers the calls you can't take in your own cloned voice, answers service questions, and books straight into Square, Wix, GlossGenius, Boulevard, Vagaro, or Fresha. Spam is screened free. New: Zolie Outreach fills empty slots with no-show rebooking, 60-day win-backs, slow-day fill, and Google review requests. The Rebooking Reminders add-on learns each client's rhythm and nudges them back before they lapse.

posts.name: TimeSpeak
posts.tagline: Google Meet Timer and Tracker
posts.description: Run more focused Google Meet meetings with saved agendas, a topic stopwatch and live estimates of each participant's speaking time. See how the conversation is shared, keep track of time and review reports after the call. TimeSpeak combines meeting planning, timers and participation insights in one Chrome extension. No recording or transcription. Meeting data stays in your browser.

posts.name: NextPM
posts.tagline: Practice PM interviews before it counts
posts.description: Practise PM interviews out loud with an AI interviewer. Product design, metrics, root cause, estimation and strategy cases, scored from what you said.

posts.name: MotionShine
posts.tagline: Free Mac screen recorder with auto zoom and a real editor
posts.description: MotionShine is a free Mac screen recorder with a camera bubble, auto zoom on every click and a smooth cursor. No watermark, no time limit. Then edit text, music, voice over and captions in the same app. Pay once for 1080p up to 4K.

posts.name: Bonded: Conversation Starters
posts.tagline: Technology should bring us closer
posts.description: We have more ways to reach each other than any generation before us, yet we’re the most disconnected one. Bonded is a question game for couples, first dates, friends, and colleagues. Pick a deck and depth; answer shared prompts out loud or pass. Guests join free in a browser, with no app or account. The app is live in Greece, Cyprus, Ireland, Spain, Portugal, and the UK.

posts.name: Bzzly
posts.tagline: Give your mobile app a free page, smart QR code and stats
posts.description: Bzzly is a honeycomb of mobile apps. Visitors tap cells to discover apps, meet a new App of the Day every 24 hours and Buzz their favorites into a weekly Trending ring. For developers it's free (up to 10 apps): paste a bundle ID and in about two minutes your app gets a cell, a page built for Google and AI assistants, a QR code that sends iPhones to the App Store and Android phones to Google Play, and live stats on where visits come from.

posts.name: Managed Deep Agents v0.9
posts.tagline: Agents that schedule their own follow-ups
posts.description: Managed Deep Agents v0.9 from LangChain adds three things for internal agents that work like teammates. Agents can now create their own reminders and recurring tasks mid-conversation, running with the requester's permissions and posting back to the same channel. One deployment can pick its model, skills, tools and sandbox on every run. And agents can react to Slack messages right away. Public beta.

posts.name: Recroid
posts.tagline: One job should feel like one job.
posts.description: The enterprise recruitment OS. AI-native screening, automated assessments, multi-tenant workflows, and a global talent fabric — built for recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, jobseekers, and universities. Recroid is an end-to-end AI recruitment platform for companies and recruiting agencies.

posts.name: Tapzy
posts.tagline: Free forms that keep bots out and verify real people
posts.description: Free online form builder for forms, surveys and quizzes. Zero spam without CAPTCHA, verified respondents and payments built in. No credit card. Tapzy is a free form builder that stops spam before it lands. Invisible bot checks, firewall rules and a trust score on every response. Verify people by email, SMS, WhatsApp or Google, take payments, and import from Typeform, Tally or Google Forms.

posts.name: Ear Wizard
posts.tagline: Train your ear with guided listening and adaptive practice
posts.description: Give listening practice a clear path. Ear Wizard offers six roadmaps for relative pitch, time signatures, rhythm, melody, chords and harmonic motion. Work through focused chapters, hear questions, and revisit sounds through adaptive practice instead of disconnected drills. Track progress as you develop interval and harmony recognition. Available in the browser, with a free starting point and optional paid upgrades for more practice and learning tools.

posts.name: Pull Presence
posts.tagline: See who else is reviewing a GitHub pull request
posts.description: Ever started reviewing a PR only to find two teammates already on it, or pinged someone who was already reading? Install Pull Presence as a team and see each other on GitHub pull requests, live. Free Chrome extension; public repos today, private soon.

posts.name: ZarSage Web Console
posts.tagline: Run every member's fields, work and evidence from one tab
posts.description: New: the ZarSage web console for teams. Co-op officers, NGO field leads and farm managers see every member's fields on one map, the work that is due, and only what needs a decision today. Ask Zari about your own records and see the sources behind each answer. Invite members with a sign-in link; one plan covers the whole team with no per-person charge. Growers keep using the phone app in the field, even offline, and ChatGPT and Claude read the same record.

posts.name: Creator Outreach Email Generator
posts.tagline: First messages and follow-ups for creator outreach
posts.description: Choose email, Instagram DM or TikTok DM, first message or a three-step follow-up sequence, and get templates that mention the deliverables, rate and usage rights up front (the three things creators ask about first). Templates, not AI, so nothing weird slips into your outreach. Free, no signup.

posts.name: Waterbreak
posts.tagline: Drink water to unlock TikTok, Instagram and other apps
posts.description: Waterbreak turns the moment you reach for your phone into a water break. Pick the apps that eat your day, like TikTok, Instagram or games. When they lock, take a few seconds' sip on camera and they unlock. Drink checking runs on your phone, so no video ever leaves it. Your daily goal comes from your weight and activity, counted in bottles, with streaks, leaderboards and collectable pixel sea monsters. Free with no ads, on iPhone and Android, in 13 languages.

posts.name: Boncourant
posts.tagline: Electricity bill audits and tariff optimization for France
posts.description: Boncourant helps French households, businesses and energy brokers audit electricity costs using invoices, contracts and actual consumption. When interval data is available, it models eligible tariffs hour by hour, including Base, peak/off-peak and Tempo. Findings cite their evidence, missing information stays explicit, and future savings remain estimates. Supplier commissions do not weight the calculations or recommendations.

posts.name: Squeeze: Photo Video Compress
posts.tagline: Shrink photos and videos to a target size, fully offline
posts.description: Squeeze compresses photos and videos on your Android phone so they fit email limits, upload forms and chat apps. Pick Balanced, Smaller, or set an exact target size in KB or MB. It handles JPEG, PNG, WebP and MP4, batches up to 20 files, and lets you compare before and after. Everything runs offline: nothing is uploaded and your originals are never replaced. All features are free, supported by a small banner ad, with no subscription.

posts.name: Squeeze: Photo Video Compress
posts.tagline: Shrink photos and videos to a target size, fully offline
posts.description: Squeeze compresses photos and videos on your Android phone so they fit email limits, upload forms and chat apps. Pick Balanced, Smaller, or set an exact target size in KB or MB. posts.tagline: Finds the companies ready to buy, and books the meetings
posts.description: Most sales tools start with a filter and give you a list of companies that look right. We start from your whole market and check every company for two things: does it have the problem you solve, and is a buying window open now. What’s different: 1) Each window has a reason, an end date and what closes it 2) Every claim links to its source 3) A plan per company: who decides, who pays, what to say 4) Your rep approves every first message 5) We send and book the meeting in your CRM

posts.name: PDF table of contents
posts.tagline: Add clickable bookmarks to PDFs, right in your browser
posts.description: Turn long PDFs into easy-to-navigate documents. Automatically detect headings, edit their hierarchy and page numbers, and download a copy with clickable bookmarks. Everything runs locally in your browser—no uploads, account, or installation. Free to use. Requires a PDF with selectable text.

posts.name: Yarkr
posts.tagline: Your team's agentic skills and config versioned and shared
posts.description: Write a skill once and every AI tool you use picks it up, on any machine. Update it in one place and the change reaches everywhere. For teams, Yarkr keeps your organization's AI know-how in one place: every change is reviewed before it ships, and each team always gets the latest version of the skills meant for it.

posts.name: DescriptorAPI
posts.tagline: Turn messy card descriptors into clean merchant data
posts.description: DescriptorAPI turns raw card statement lines into clean merchant data: name, logo, category, website, city, and payment processor, with a confidence score. Arabic included. 500 free calls a month, no card required, and you only pay for matches.

posts.name: PsicoSuite
posts.tagline: Practice managament app for mantal health professionals
posts.description: Practice software for therapists, psychologists, and clinics: scheduling, teletherapy, patient records, notes, and billing. 30-day free trial.

posts.name: ai-usage
posts.tagline: Know before your Claude Code or Codex quota runs out
posts.description: A small open-source tool that shows what's left of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok limits on every machine you run, and whether it will last until the reset. No account, no config. Mac menu bar app included.

posts.name: FrameGrab
posts.tagline: Frame-accurate video, for you and your AI agent
posts.description: FrameGrab is a free Mac app for frame-accurate video. Trim any video to the exact frame and export stills at full resolution. Connect Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP agent, and it can record your app, find the animation and check every frame for glitches.

posts.name: AI PM Job Board by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: AI product manager jobs from top AI companies, one page each
posts.description: Open AI product manager roles from Anthropic, OpenAI, Glean, Decagon, Harvey and other top AI companies, each with its own readable page. From any posting you can start a mock interview built from that job description, check your resume fit, or jump to the company's real interview questions. Free.

posts.name: PulseTiles
posts.tagline: Snap any Mac window into place, by drag, key or launcher
posts.description: PulseTiles snaps Mac windows into halves, thirds and quarters. Hold ⌘ and drag onto a zone, press a ⌃⌥ shortcut, or open the right ⌘ + / launcher. Save arrangements, record your keys. 7-day free trial, then $4.99 once. No accounts, no tracking.

posts.name: NutriMeter
posts.tagline: Track. Learn. Thrive.
posts.description: NutriMeter is an AI nutrition tracker that turns your food log into personalised calorie, macro & micronutrient insights from real dietitians and advanced AI. Join the iOS TestFlight or Android beta.

posts.name: TF Diagrams
posts.tagline: Turn your Terraform code into cloud diagrams in seconds!
posts.description: Free Terraform visualizer that turnstf files into interactive AWS, Google Cloud and Azure architecture diagrams and dependency graphs, entirely in the browser.

posts.name: NotchClean
posts.tagline: A cleaner Windows PC, one tiny notch away.
posts.description: Clean junk, reclaim memory, and monitor your Windows PC. Try NotchClean free for 7 days. No credit card or signup required. Lifetime licenses from $9.99.

posts.name: Wymagine
posts.tagline: Image Generator Agent - Wymagine AI
posts.description: Create, edit, and refine images with Wymagine’s free AI image generator agent. Start with a prompt or reference image, then use follow-up instructions to improve the result.

posts.name: District 27
posts.tagline: One family outing, picked for your day
posts.description: District27 helps families choose what to do in Cape Town, Johannesburg, Durban and Pretoria. Pick your city, day and who's coming, including the kids' ages, and get one outing suggestion with practical details and a ticket link.

posts.name: MyRetroTunes
posts.tagline: Watch music videos across seven decades in a starship
posts.description: A starship gallery of Earth's living rooms: channel-surf the music videos of every decade from 1950 through 2019.

posts.name: Guise
posts.tagline: Make your designs feel like a shipped product
posts.description: Guise is a native Mac app that presents designs, websites, and live Figma prototypes in focused macOS windows. Make presentations clearer, record your work like a real product with your usual screen recorder, and review the details without surrounding design tool UI. Capture screenshots, then annotate and export visual feedback with Guise Complete. Built for designers and founders who care about how their work is seen.

posts.name: Grol
posts.tagline: World First AI Agentic Browser
posts.description: Grol is World first AI agentic browser for macOS. Tell it what you want in one sentence, it reads the page, clicks, types and finishes the task, then hands control back to you for anything that matters.

posts.name: ImageToBlock
posts.tagline: Convert any image into Minecraft block pixel art,
posts.description: Professional image to Minecraft block pixel art and blueprint generator. Convert photos to wool, concrete, terracotta palettes with blueprints and material shopping lists.

posts.name: DecisionsAPI.app
posts.tagline: High-speed constrained AI decision making with deterministic
posts.description: The complete developer guide, latency benchmarks, and architectural hub for OpenAI Decisions API powered by the ultra-fast Luna model (~150ms).

posts.name: Branchway
posts.tagline: A calmer Mac file manager that searches inside your files
posts.description: A native Finder replacement. ⌘K search takes a path, a name or a plain sentence, finds photos by what is in them and, with an on-device model, passages in PDFs, Office files and video moments. Tabs, dual panes, disk map, Large Files, Clean Up, themes. 14-day trial.

posts.name: Letterbloom
posts.tagline: Type a word, pick an effect, export it anywhere
posts.description: Letterbloom turns any word into sticker, holo, neon, gold-leaf or gradient type. 82 effects, layers, shapes, photos with on-device background removal and motion. Export PNG, SVG, GIF or up to 4K video, with transparent clips. Free in your browser, no sign-up.

posts.name: Anomaly Graph
posts.tagline: Source-linked research across UFO and paranormal reports
posts.description: Search reported details across UFO records, paranormal accounts, folklore and historical sources. Compare exact phrases and related language, follow source links, and keep documentary records, contextual material and AI-sourced dossiers visibly separate. A public research library and practical guides support further investigation; a shared detail is a lead, not proof of a shared cause.

posts.name: Persi
posts.tagline: The guilt-free habit tracker. No subscription, no account
posts.description: Persi is a habit tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch where missing a day doesn't break your streak: each habit gets a few days of slack. One tap to log, widgets, timed sessions, Siri, iCloud sync with no account. 7 days free, then pay once. No subscription.

posts.name: Orbi Transfer
posts.tagline: Free, no-signup, file transfers instantly
posts.description: Send files, folders, photos, videos and links instantly between any two devices. Free, no login required, no signup, up to 20 GB, end-to-end encrypted, auto-deleted after 5–30 minutes.

posts.name: MELRA
posts.tagline: Safer MCP tool execution with approvals and recovery
posts.description: An agent can finish a write even when its response gets lost. Retrying may duplicate the change. MELRA is an open-source local runtime for MCP and CLI tools. It checks policy and scoped approvals before actions, verifies declared outcomes, and keeps a redacted record. An interrupted HTTP write with an unclear result is parked for reconciliation instead of replayed. Alpha software; requires Node.js 22.13+.

posts.name: Shift-Left API
posts.tagline: AI-powered, no-code API Testing: functional, load & security
posts.description: Shift-Left API is an all-in-one, AI-powered, no-code API testing platform for functional, performance, and security testing. Generate tests from requirements, API specs, and Postman Collections. Test REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs, from individual endpoints to end-to-end workflows. Mock dependent services, run load and security tests, analyze coverage, and integrate with CI/CD. Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or self-hosted LLMs to keep your data within your perimeter.

posts.name: Everyday
posts.tagline: "Locket" app for running
posts.description: Everyday makes running feel less lonely. Track your runs, save your milestones, and share progress with your crew.

posts.name: Rdyrct - URL Shortener for Teams
posts.tagline: Shorten a link. See who clicks it.
posts.description: Branded short links, QR codes, and campaign analytics for teams. Track clicks by country, referrer, device, and UTM campaign without storing IP addresses. Share workspaces with role-based access, automate with scoped API keys, or connect through MCP. Start on the free hosted plan or self-host the MIT-licensed app on Cloudflare.

posts.name: MegaMegaTypeType
posts.tagline: The world’s biggest index of the world's best typefaces.
posts.description: On a mission to create the world's biggest index of typefaces from the world's best type foundries.

posts.name: Moat Check
posts.tagline: Find out who will copy your startup, before they do
posts.description: Describe your startup idea. Get its real competitors, the company most likely to copy you and how fast, and a moat score from 10 tests. Free.

posts.name: Discurso.AI Public Launch
posts.tagline: The science-based negotiation teaching and learning tool
posts.description: Practice negotiation against realistic AI counterparts that bluff, push back and adapt to you. Get instant feedback on your anchoring, concessions and value creation, and track how your skills grow over time. Teaching negotiation? Assign exercises to your whole class, let students practice anytime, and assess their competencies without reading hours of transcripts. Already used in university courses across several continents. Start practicing one of the most important skills free on Discurso.AI.

posts.name: Actium
posts.tagline: Turn any self-help book into small tasks you do today
posts.description: Pick any self-help book. Each morning, one chapter becomes 2–3 small tasks to do today, in the author’s order. It was created because the author noticed that most self-help books get read, then forgotten. Actium turns them into action.

posts.name: Lighthouse Legal
posts.tagline: Precision AI voice agents for personal injury intake.
posts.description: Lighthouse Legal provides 24/7 AI intake for personal injury law firms. Screen callers against your criteria and escalate qualified calls to an attorney.

posts.name: StreamOTG
posts.tagline: Streaming search, simplified
posts.description: StreamOTG instantly shows where any movie or show is streaming across all your apps. No more switching platforms or searching endlessly — just fast, clear results. The MVP focuses on speed, simplicity, and accuracy. Coming soon: subscription activation, show‑migration alerts, and universal Watch‑Now launching. Streaming should be simple, and StreamOTG makes it feel that way.

posts.name: Hum - Voice Conversations
posts.tagline: Clubhouse, but 1:1. Free voice networking, interest based.
posts.description: A voice-first social app, like Clubhouse. But one-on-one, and it speaks from 6PM to midnight every evening - the Golden hour. Hum lets you connect with with people who share your interests. No photos, no swiping, no text. Every evening. 6PM - 12 AM -> Golden Hours The app doesn't allow calls outside Golden Hours. After every call you both decide privately to keep each other, else you depart once the call disconnect. If connected, you have earned a voice who shares your interest to connect later.
